comment: Ratcheting line-coverage floor for the CTOC test-gate (src/scripts/test-gate.js). The gate fails when measured suite coverage drops below minPct. This is a RATCHET like .ctoc/typecheck-baseline.json: it records the measured floor for a codebase that predates coverage instrumentation and may only ever be RAISED as coverage improves — NEVER lowered to make a failing run pass. New code is still held to >= 80% at review (Iron Loop Step 14).
